display.purpose: Self-hosted Ubuntu for documentation display and section headings.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The principal action in the viewer.
components.css: .ds-primary { background: var(--primary, #315ab7); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 14px; font: 600 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background .15s; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #25488f); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #315ab7); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search field
components.css: .ds-search { height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--bg-base, #f7f8fa); color: var(--text-primary, #1c2530); border: 1px solid var(--border, #dce2e8); border-radius: 6px; font: 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #315ab7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected event
components.description: A selected row in the request ledger.
components.css: .ds-event { padding: 17px 20px; background: var(--bg-selected, #edf2fc); color: var(--text-primary, #1c2530); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #dce2e8); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 var(--primary, #315ab7); font: 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-event code { font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Active endpoint
components.description: The selected endpoint in the sidebar.
components.css: .ds-endpoint { display: block; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--bg-selected, #edf2fc); color: var(--text-primary, #1c2530); font: 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-endpoint:hover { background: var(--bg-hover, #e9edf3); } .ds-endpoint:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #315ab7); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A precise developer tool and technical manual. Data leads, supported by fine rules, restrained color, and clear alignment.
keyCharacteristics: Ubuntu documentation headings, system sans-serif interface, and monospace technical values
dos: Keep request details more prominent than decoration.
Pair status color with text and preserve visible focus.
donts: Do not surround routine ledger content with floating cards.
